title: Working with Hospitals to Increase Use of Infant Car Seats
what_it_is: Working with Hospitals to Increase Use of Infant Car Seats

sections.label: Child restraint solutions availability
sections.summary: A range of child restraint solutions are available in the market, and there are no plans to work with hospitals to increase access to infant car seats.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: A range of child restraint solutions are available in the market.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We have no plans to work with hospitals to further increase access to the use of infant car seats.

sections.label: Traffic Police KKH road safety partnership
sections.summary: The Traffic Police has partnered KK Women's and Children's Hospital to educate the public on road safety, including child passengers, and provided input for educational collaterals on child car seats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I believe the Senior Parliamentary Secretary said all these will be looked into.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: And since then, we have checked with the agencies to understand that currently the Traffic Police has partnered KK Women's and Children's Hospital (KKH) to educate the public on road safety, including road safety for child passengers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: For example, the Traffic Police provided input for KKH's educational collaterals on the use of use of child car seats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Such collaborations have been increasing awareness among parents, especially new parents, about the requirements for child restraints and their correct use.

sections.label: Infant car seats healthcare subsidies
sections.summary: Infant car seats are not within the scope of healthcare subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Infant car seats are not within the scope of healthcare subsidies.
